combo_label: Christmas × Fossil Hunting × The Great Plague

entries.clue: Bullet-shaped internal guard left behind by a squid-like Jurassic animal
Diarist who stayed in the capital through 1665 and set the year down
Holed boundary marker where coins lay in vinegar to pay for supplies
Cold cuts and reheated extras that feed the household for days afterwards
Strip between high and low water where loose beach finds may be collected
Wax column burning down on a windowsill through a long evening service
Red sign a foot long daubed on the door of an infected house
Serrated black triangle on the strandline, shed by an ancient shark
Great trench dug when the churchyards could take no more burials
Bottled grape drink, mulled with spice and orange at a December market
